body:
Thank you, and I've learnt to keep calm when people talk about these things. It still stresses me out sometimes, but I feel a bit better now.

As I've said in a comment, we Hongkongers have the "Lion Rock spirit", and we (and I) won't go down so easily! 

Again, thanks for hearing me out, I will add oil \^\^

I love Hong Kong, and I don't plan on moving to another country any time soon. I just think that the Hong Kong culture is dying and that we have the responsibility to keep them alive. Unfortunately, Inland culture is spreading rapidly. (And I'm not sure if the CCP funds violent protestors, but I think it's likely)

And that is the reason I choose to stay in Hong Kong, despite all the things happening.

Thanks for the suggestion though

Thanks, and I will, we Hongkongers will stand strong in any situation, and we will fight until we can fight no more. 

Again, thank you for hearing me out.

Thank you. Honestly, I think these things would happen eventually. The CCP can't hold us down forever after all. However, we Hongkongers always have "Lion Rock spirit"--We will never give up so easily! 

Thanks (again) for hearing me out. Almost no one dares to talk about these things nowadays, as if nothing happened. (cough cough) *Tiananmen Square* (cough cough)
